entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I... I think I need to return something. It's the new VeloBand Pulse monitor.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, um, I don't think it's broken. It's just... really confusing. I find it so hard to use. I even read the whole user manual, but I'm just overwhelmed.
I see. So it's not meeting your expectations in terms of usability?
Yes, exactly! I just expected more, you know? For it to be simpler. The website made it look so easy. Can't you just help me? I'd really just prefer to send it back.
I understand completely. Let me just confirm your order details and check the return eligibility. I see you received the VeloBand Pulse on December 15th, is that correct?
Yes, that sounds right. It was a couple of weeks ago.
Okay, that was 17 days ago. One moment while I review our policy.

Alright, thank you for your patience. I've checked our knowledge base, and all of our items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. Since you're well within that timeframe, I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you.
Oh, really? That's wonderful! I was so worried it would be a problem. That's a huge relief.

Not a problem at all. I'm sending a prepaid return label and instructions to the email we have on file for you right now. Just place the device back in its original packaging, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any local post office.
That's perfect. Thank you so much for your help, Charlie.

You are very welcome. Once our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 5-7 business days. Was there anything else I could assist you with for VeloFit today?
No, that was it. Thanks again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great start to your new year.
